ryan.s: Heads up — Boreal is seeing a p99 jump for embeddings since last deploy. Customers report some requests timing out, others slow to 10–12s. Seen on eu-west-1 only.
elena.support: Oh no. Any error codes or request ids?
ryan.s: Mostly 504s and a few 429s with tenant throttle headers. Example request-id: `req_0a7f3b9c`. Attaching short curl we used for repro.
ryan.s: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["test"]}' -v
```
leo.infra: Deploy bot shows a batch model rollout at 2045676000, but nothing obvious flagged. Checking autoscaler and per-tenant queueing. :eyes:
deploy-bot: rollout/embedding-optimizer v2 -> v3 completed at 2045676015 by @maria.cs
maria.cs: That rollout changed batch size heuristics for embeds (64->128) and enabled a new KV caching path. I did run perf tests but maybe distribution differs for Boreal's traffic.
sasha.ml: Boreal's workload has lots of small inputs and very bursty spikes — bigger batches can increase tail if the system waits to fill. Could be batching latency vs throughput tradeoff.
leo.infra: Looking at tenant queue metrics for tenant=boreal-prod: concurrent inflight jumped, queue depth backed up, and per-tenant token bucket hit limit triggers 429. Their average token cost per embed is higher due to long contexts.
elena.support: Boreal is on a shared reservation, not dedicated. They asked about reserved capacity earlier but didn't want to commit.
ryan.s: CS asked if we can do a short-term mitigation while we dig: something like a temporary lease of extra concurrency or a routing bypass for embeddings from their tenant id.
leo.infra: I can add an ephemeral reservation for tenant=boreal-prod for 2 hours (fast path, +25% concurrency). Will take ~5 min to apply. Anyone object?
maria.cs: Do it. Also revert the batch-size change on the route for that tenant to 64, that should cut p99. I can push a per-tenant override flag.
leo.infra: Applying ephemeral reservation and per-tenant config now. Will post when active.
ops-bot: policy-update: ephemeral-reservation applied -> tenant=boreal-prod, concurrency:+25%, ttl:7200s
leo.infra: Done — reservation active and embed batchSize override set to 64 for boreal-prod.
sasha.ml: Monitoring KV hit rates — cache warm-up might take a minute.
ryan.s: Early telemetry: p50 unchanged, p95 down from 1.8s to 1.2s, p99 down from 11.4s to 2.9s. :party_parrot:
elena.support: Passing numbers to the customer. Thanks team, they were getting tickets.
maria.cs: Longer-term: we should add a per-tenant batching heuristic to avoid pulling small-input customers into large batch waits. Filing a short RFC.
leo.infra: Also will add alerting on per-tenant queue depth spikes so we catch this before customer tickets.
ryan.s: Thanks all. I'll keep the ephemeral reservation until tomorrow morning and then we can transition to either reserved capacity or adaptive throttles.
ops-bot: reminder: ephemeral-reservation for boreal-prod expires in 23h 59m (can extend).
ryan.s: Marking this thread resolved for now, will reopen if we see regression. :thumbsup:
